name: hud_layout_hw_global_destructor
description: HudLayoutHW::GlobalDestructor destroys the four embedded HUD widgets in reverse construction order and then destroys the base container.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; the MSVC EH destructor frame is deferred to the HUD layout source-cluster tier S pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly/HLIL for 0x40d330 shows HudUiWidget::DestructorCore calls for members at offsets 0x27c, 0x1b4, 0xec, and 0x30, then HudUiContainer::DestructorCore on this.
The native smoke invokes HudLayoutHW::GlobalDestructor on a constructed layout and verifies the embedded widget ftable resets and container ftable reset.
